angle_grid_policy: first-case native farfieldangle grid frozen; all cases must match within 1e-6 deg (native export floating quantization)
angular_convention: farfieldangle radians converted to degrees; +theta toward +x from upward +y air-side normal
filter_definition: raw unfiltered farfield2d intensity; no wavelength-independent angular substitution
marginal_closure_policy: recompute both marginals from raw joint tensor using radians for both theta and wavelength quadrature
mask_policy: reject nonfinite bins; no silent clipping; intensity negatives below -1e-15 reject
raw_power_denominator: retain p_box_raw and p_up_raw; no pre-normalization
